'''Sense Force Potential''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] in the Sense family of abilities. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] could use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to probe the mind of another to determine whether or not that individual had the potential to use the Force. The subconscious of a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] was protected by a barrier that prevented another Force user from invading their mind. The barrier violently rejected the probe as an involuntarily defense mechanism. Jedi seeking to see if an individual was Force-sensitive could deliberately stimulate the area in order to trigger a reaction.

The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were prolific users of this ability when determining who they would train. [[Aleema Keto]] was known to have known how to do this.<ref name="TOTJC" /> [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] found that [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Zannah]] was a young woman of great potential<ref>''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref> and that her [[Darovit|cousin]] was barely able to touch the Force.<ref>''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref> In their centuries of hiding, the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith of Bane's line]] often used this power to find useful individuals to be taken on as [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentices]].<ref>[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] also used this skill, discovering a boy, [[Reezen]], who was sensitive to the Force. Vader did not train him, but did tell Reezen that he should trust his special senses in life.<ref>''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>
